units.en: For the Formable nations main page, see Formable nations.
List of formable nations in South America
The following are nations that are formed primarily by decision in the ⟦0⟧ file or any other decision file labeled as formable nation decisions.
The following are nations that are formed primarily by decision outside of the ⟦0⟧ file in .txt files not labeled as formable nations.
The following nations are formed by other means.
Union of Latin American Socialist Republics
United Kingdom of Brazil and Portugal

This formable nation created by ⟦0⟧ marks the re-establishment of the short-lived Federal League from 1815 to 1820 that will help the tiny nation to take its place as a greater power in South American affairs. It can be created if Uruguay conquers the two states of Región Mesopotámica and Santa Fe from ⟦1⟧.

This nation represents the greater form of ⟦0⟧ that existed from 1819 when the Spanish colony of New Granada declared independence and broke off from ⟦1⟧ and lasted until 1831 when the nation broke apart and lost its former lands. This makes ⟦2⟧ the legitimate successor state but the nation can be formed by any of the eligible nations. If formed by Peru, it will have more cores than if formed by any other nation, as in that case the entirety of Peru would be core territory as opposed to just Pastaza and Loreto.
Note that ⟦0⟧ can form both ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧.

This nation is formable through ⟦0⟧ non-aligned path, where the Mapuche overthrow the government in a civil war and seek to liberate the indigenous people in the Americas through a crusade of anti-imperialism. By the end of this crusade, all Amerindian and Polynesian people will be freed and federated in a single nation without a European or colonial presence in continental America and Polynesian Islands.

In order to form this nation, the player has to go down the focus path ⟦0⟧, followed shortly by committing to ⟦1⟧. Throughout this path, the player will work towards a civil war where they'll become the Mapuche State against Chile after the completion of the focus ⟦2⟧.

In this path the player will be able to unlock decisions to liberate both Amerindian and Polynesian states from European nations and former European colonies in both North and South America, from ⟦0⟧ to ⟦1⟧, into indigenous ruled subject states. Examples of these indigenous subject states are the ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and the ⟦4⟧.
Upon completion of the focus ⟦0⟧, the Grand Federation of Amerindian People will be formed and all indigenous subject states are annexed and cored.

Through forming this nation, it is possible to obtain cores on nearly all states in both continental North and South America, assuming the player liberates all possible indigenous subject states before completing ⟦0⟧. The only states on the American continents the player are unable to core are Buenos Aires (278), San Luis y La Pampa (958), Mendoza (511), San Juan y La Rioja (960), Tucumán (508), Los Andes (959), Chaco Austral (509) and Santa Fe (956) in northern Argentina.
The nations of ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ both have the ability to form a new, greater version of the starting nation through their shared focus tree branch.

As a part of their shared focus tree, both nations have a branch starting with the focus ⟦0⟧ for Paraguay and ⟦1⟧ for Uruguay. These allow player choose to aim towards forming either ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧. This focus gives the player the ability to wage war against and white peace ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ once they control the states needed to form the Greater nation within a year of starting the war. At the completion of the shared focus ⟦6⟧, either Greater Paraguay or Greater Uruguay will be formed and the respective states are cored.
Beneath the Shadow of the Triple Alliance
Demand a Seat at the High Table
To form Greater Paraguay, the states needed are Punta Porá (504) and Formosa (957).
To form Greater Uruguay, the states needed are Rio Grande Do Sul (502) and Región Mesopotámica (510).
⟦0⟧ can form this for ⟦1⟧ via decision when it goes down the ⟦2⟧ path, they unlock decisions in the focus ⟦3⟧. Letting you re-organize ⟦4⟧ into ⟦5⟧.

The Guian Federal Republic is a formable nation that can be created by one of the three states Guyana, Suriname or Guyana after breaking free of their colonial rulers of the ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. Once they are free, the three South American nations have to be united to enable the formation. Even though the Guianan Federal Republic can get cores on some states of ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧, those two nations can't form Guiana.
Chilean Kingdom of El Dorado Satellite
Chile can form this formable for Suriname in the focus ⟦0⟧ in which it unlocks decisions to establish puppets. Suriname is one of them and forms the non-aligned version: Grand Kingdom of El Dorado.

The ⟦0⟧ is a nation formed through the focus tree of ⟦1⟧ through its fascist path and completing ⟦2⟧. The Hispanic Empire allows the player to unite Hispanic territories and integrate them as core states through decisions. This formable allows the player to core all of ⟦3⟧, the Caribbean, Central America and parts of south western ⟦4⟧.
It can also be formed in the communist branch. It will be known as ⟦0⟧.
The Kingdom of Chile is formed through ⟦0⟧'s fascist focus path. Chile can choose whether to align themselves to the ⟦1⟧, or to forge their own path in South America.

To form this nation, the player needs to progress down through the fascist focus branch towards either ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ and continue further down either of these paths. To form the Kingdom of Chile, Chile needs to control all the states necessary in Argentina listed in the focus ⟦2⟧ and complete the focus. This gives Chile cores on the controlled land, changes the nation's color and flag, and sets them up to form an empire in the Pacific.
This is formed when Chile completes the focus ⟦0⟧ and after annexing Bolivia, releases it as a puppet.
The Plurinational State of Bolivia can be formed by democratic ⟦0⟧ using the decision ⟦1⟧. For this to work, the country needs to control just one non-core state.
Chilean re-organized Plurinational State of Bolivia
If ⟦0⟧ re-organizes Bolivia, these are the names.

The Peru-Bolivian Confederation is a formable nation that can be created both by ⟦0⟧ or by ⟦1⟧ - as the name suggests. Once one of the two states completely controls the other, the decision becomes executable.

Upon formation, the country color changes to red and all required states will be cored. The states cored but not owned by the opposite country will be cored and two bordering ⟦0⟧ states will also be cored.
⟦0⟧ can form this for ⟦1⟧ in the fascist branch of the focus tree. They will have to do the focus ⟦2⟧ where Uruguay gets an event to submit to ⟦3⟧. If they accept, they will become ⟦4⟧.

The nation of ⟦0⟧ is formable through the focus tree of ⟦1⟧, through it's non-aligned path starting with the focus ⟦2⟧. Throughout this path, ⟦3⟧ will crown the Frenchman Antoine III as king and lay claims on land in South America, as well as French territories and historical territorial claims with the ability to core them through integration decisions.

⟦0⟧ is formed at the very end of this focus branch, where ⟦1⟧ overthrows Antoine III and crowns Carlos Ibáñez del Campo as king through the focus ⟦2⟧. In order to be able to start this focus however, the player needs to have completed the focus ⟦3⟧ earlier on in the focus branch, otherwise they will be locked out of the option to form ⟦4⟧.
The nation's name and color changes upon formation.
United Collectives of the Southern Andes

The Second Argentine Republic is a nation that is formable through ⟦0⟧'s democratic focus branch. By progressing through the focus branch, the player will be able to either align themselves with the Allies or form their own faction and be a bastion of democracy in South America.

To form the Second Argentine Republic, the player needs to complete the focus ⟦0⟧ at the end of the focus branch. Upon formation, the nation's color and name changes and the Second Argentine Republic guarantees the independence of all democratic nations in South America.

The Fourth Reich is a secret nation available for ⟦0⟧ through a hidden focus branch. To be able to see this focus branch and form The Fourth Reich, Argentina needs to have completed the focus ⟦1⟧ before the capital of the ⟦2⟧ Berlin is occupied while Adolf Hitler is the leader of Germany. After the completion of this focus and within a month after Berlins fall, an event will fire that allows the player to hand the government over to a strange visitor.

Should you give this stranger control of Argentina, the hidden focus branch will appear and allow the formation of the Fourth Reich by completing ⟦0⟧. As the Fourth Reich, the player will be able to gain cores on all of Germany, wargoals against non-fascist nations in South America, nuclear technology and a ship through progressing further down the hidden focus branch.
The event needed to form The Fourth Reich will fire if Berlin is occupied at any point in the game, including during the German civil war initiated through the German alternate history path.
